ink.$description: Compatibility inverse band uses primary-action ink; focusable content uses focus-inverse.

text-inverse.$description: Light Figma semantic on-action; compatibility role text-inverse.

border.$description: Light Figma semantic control; compatibility role border. Control boundary: 3.2154:1 on fog and 3.5141:1 on white.

focus.$description: Light Figma semantic focus; compatibility role focus.

action.$description: Light Figma semantic action; compatibility role action.

action-hover.$description: Light Figma semantic action-hover; compatibility role action-hover.

action-pressed.$description: Light Figma semantic action-pressed; compatibility role action-pressed.

link-visited.$description: Compatibility extension retained from the previous operational system; not a new Figma semantic. Contrast is checked on its actual supported surfaces.

selected.$description: Compatibility selected surface maps to Figma brand-tint; selection still requires a text or shape cue.

brand-tint.$description: Light Figma semantic brand-tint; supporting selection surface.

sans.$description: Self-hosted Noto Sans (latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, greek) with Noto Sans Hebrew (§11.3). Hebrew pages put Noto Sans Hebrew first (src/ui/base.css).

display.$description: Self-hosted licensed Manrope variable face for display/title roles; Noto script fallbacks remain available. Hebrew gives Noto Sans Hebrew priority.

typography.$description: Type roles (ux-spec §06.1). Headings scale by content and wrap; they are not fixed-height boxes.

subheading.$description: Compatibility typography role retained for existing component anatomy; Noto Sans, not a new Figma text style.

price.$description: Compatibility typography role retained for existing component anatomy; Noto Sans, not a new Figma text style.

compact.$description: Compatibility typography role retained for existing component anatomy; Noto Sans, not a new Figma text style.

operational.$description: Figma UI/14: Noto Sans 14/22; supporting data, not essential public body copy.

dense.$description: Figma UI/14: Noto Sans 14/22; supporting data, not essential public body copy.

caption.$description: Figma UI/14: Noto Sans 14/22; supporting data, not essential public body copy.

spacing.$description: 4 px base; the shared scale is 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 (ux-spec §06.1).

control.$description: Comfort target for primary touch controls (§11.3).

breakpoint.$description: Layout adaptation ranges, not device detection: compact < 640, medium 640–1023, desktop 1024–1439, wide ≥ 1440 (§11.3).

panel.$description: Cards and panels where grouping is useful (ux-spec §06.1).

duration.$description: Motion is orientation and feedback only, 150–200 ms (ux-spec §06.3).
